claims.text: Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV over 30 s, repeated q6–8h for the first 24 h;
claims.quote: Hydrocortisone 100 mg is injected IV over 30 seconds and repeated every 6 to 8 hours for the first 24 hours.

claims.text: then usually 150 mg over the second 24 h and 75 mg on the third day if markedly improved,
claims.quote: A total dose of 150 mg hydrocortisone is usually given over the second 24-hour period if the patient has improved markedly, and 75 mg is given on the third day.

claims.text: then oral maintenance (hydrocortisone 15–20 mg + fludrocortisone 0.1 mg daily).
claims.quote: Maintenance oral doses of hydrocortisone (15 to 20 mg) and fludrocortisone (0.1 mg) are given daily thereafter

claims.text: Any delay in glucocorticoid, including for testing, may be fatal.
claims.quote: When adrenal crisis is suspected, treat with hydrocortisone immediately; any delay, including for testing, may be fatal.
